description: issue #689: `set_tempo 90` (Sound profile, arity 1) sets the tempo `note`/`play`/`rest` will read (default 120) and emits exactly one `sound` event with payload {command:"set_tempo", beats_per_minute:90}, AFTER the tempo state has been scheduled (spec/interaction-events.md#trace-stream-integration). Durations are in beats, never wall-clock; the stream is deterministic and headless.
